def load_json(path):
    with open(path, "r") as f:
        return json.load(f)


def load_data():
    if os.path.exists("data/train.json"):
        train = load_json("data/train.json")
    else:
        train = load_json("data/train/train.json")

    if os.path.exists("data/test.json"):
        test = load_json("data/test.json")
    else:
        test = load_json("data/test/test.json")

    return pd.DataFrame(train), pd.DataFrame(test)


def to_list(x):
    if x is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(x, np.ndarray):
        x = x.tolist()
    if isinstance(x, list):
        return [s for s in x if isinstance(s, str) and s]
    if isinstance(x, str):
        s = x.strip()
        if not s or s.lower() == "nan":
            return []
        try:
            v = json.loads(s)
            if isinstance(v, list):
                return [item for item in v if isinstance(item, str) and item]
        except Exception:
            pass
        return [x]
    return []


def unique_ratio_from_text(s):
    words = str(s).split()
    if not words:
        return 0.0
    return len(set(words)) / (len(words) + 1.0)

    out = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)

    def num(col):
        if col not in df.columns:

    tz_diff = (

    username = (

def add_time_context(base, all_ts):
    ts = base["_ts"].values.astype(float)
    all_ts = np.asarray(all_ts, dtype=float)
    all_ts = np.sort(all_ts[all_ts > 0])

    if len(all_ts) == 0:
        base["days_since_start"] = 0.0
        base["requests_before"] = 0.0
        base["prev_7d"] = 0.0
        base["prev_30d"] = 0.0
        base["log_requests_before"] = 0.0
        base["log_prev_7d"] = 0.0
        base["log_prev_30d"] = 0.0
        return base

    day = 86400.0
    min_ts = all_ts.min()

    base["days_since_start"] = np.where(ts > 0, (ts - min_ts) / day, 0.0)
    idx = np.searchsorted(all_ts, ts, side="left")
    base["requests_before"] = idx
    base["prev_7d"] = idx - np.searchsorted(all_ts, ts - 7 * day, side="left")
    base["prev_30d"] = idx - np.searchsorted(all_ts, ts - 30 * day, side="left")
    base["log_requests_before"] = np.log1p(base["requests_before"])
    base["log_prev_7d"] = np.log1p(base["prev_7d"])
    base["log_prev_30d"] = np.log1p(base["prev_30d"])
    return base


def rolling_global_features(ts, y, update_mask):
    ts = np.asarray(ts, dtype=float)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=float)
    update_mask = np.asarray(update_mask, dtype=bool)

    n = len(ts)
    feat = np.zeros((n, 14))

    labeled_idx = np.where(update_mask)[0]
    if len(labeled_idx) == 0:
        return feat

    order = labeled_idx[np.argsort(ts[labeled_idx], kind="mergesort")]
    sts = ts[order]
    sy = y[order]
    cs = np.cumsum(sy)
    prior = float(np.mean(sy))

    k = np.searchsorted(sts, ts, side="left")

    cnt = k.astype(float)
    s = np.zeros(n)
    idx = k > 0
    s[idx] = cs[k[idx] - 1]
    rate = np.where(cnt > 0, s / np.maximum(cnt, 1), prior)
    feat[:, 0] = cnt
    feat[:, 1] = rate

    l = np.maximum(k - 100, 0)
    cnt100 = (k - l).astype(float)
    s100 = np.zeros(n)
    idx = k > 0
    s100[idx] = cs[k[idx] - 1]
    lidx = l > 0
    s100[lidx] -= cs[l[lidx] - 1]
    rate100 = np.where(cnt100 > 0, s100 / np.maximum(cnt100, 1), prior)
    feat[:, 8] = cnt100
    feat[:, 9] = rate100

    for wi, (window, col_count, col_rate, log_col) in enumerate(
        [
            (7 * 86400.0, 2, 3, 11),
            (30 * 86400.0, 4, 5, 12),
            (90 * 86400.0, 6, 7, 13),
        ]
    ):
        lw = np.searchsorted(sts, ts - window, side="left")
        cntw = (k - lw).astype(float)
        sw = np.zeros(n)
        idx = k > 0
        sw[idx] = cs[k[idx] - 1]
        lidx = lw > 0
        sw[lidx] -= cs[l[lidx] - 1]
        ratew = np.where(cntw > 0, sw / np.maximum(cntw, 1), prior)
        feat[:, col_count] = cntw
        feat[:, col_rate] = ratew

    feat[:, 10] = np.log1p(feat[:, 0])
    feat[:, 11] = np.log1p(feat[:, 2])
    feat[:, 12] = np.log1p(feat[:, 4])
    feat[:, 13] = np.log1p(feat[:, 6])

    return feat


def compute_temporal_features(
    texts,
    sub_lists,
    ts,
    y,
    update_mask,
    word_vec,
    smoothing=10.0,
    half_life=180 * 86400.0,
):
    n = len(texts)
    ts = np.asarray(ts, dtype=float)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=float)
    update_mask = np.asarray(update_mask, dtype=bool)

    prior = float(np.mean(y[update_mask])) if update_mask.any() else 0.0

    Xhash = word_vec.transform(texts).tocsr()

    sub_stats = {}
    word_stats = {}

    sub_mean_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_max_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_min_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_wmean_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_mean_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_max_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_min_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_known = np.zeros(n)
    sub_avg_count = np.zeros(n)

    word_mean_full = np.full(n, prior)
    word_max_full = np.full(n, prior)
    word_min_full = np.full(n, prior)
    word_mean_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    word_max_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    word_min_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    word_known = np.zeros(n)

    sort_idx = np.argsort(ts, kind="mergesort")
    sorted_ts = ts[sort_idx]
    unique_ts, first_pos = np.unique(sorted_ts, return_index=True)

    for gi, t in enumerate(unique_ts):
        start = first_pos[gi]
        end = first_pos[gi + 1] if gi + 1 < len(first_pos) else n
        group = sort_idx[start:end]

        for idx in group:
            subs = sub_lists[idx]
            if subs:
                scores_full = []
                scores_ew = []
                weights = []
                known = 0
                total_count = 0

                for s in set(subs):
                    st = sub_stats.get(s)
                    if st is None:
                        continue
                    known += 1
                    if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                        decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                    else:
                        decay = 1.0
                    cur_es = st["ew_sum"] * decay
                    cur_ec = st["ew_count"] * decay
                    rate_full = (st["sum"] + smoothing * prior) / (
                        st["count"] + smoothing
                    )
                    rate_ew = (cur_es + smoothing * prior) / (cur_ec + smoothing)
                    scores_full.append(rate_full)
                    scores_ew.append(rate_ew)
                    w = max(st["count"], 1.0)
                    weights.append(w)
                    total_count += st["count"]

                if scores_full:
                    arr_f = np.array(scores_full, dtype=float)
                    arr_e = np.array(scores_ew, dtype=float)
                    w_arr = np.array(weights, dtype=float)
                    sub_mean_full[idx] = arr_f.mean()
                    sub_max_full[idx] = arr_f.max()
                    sub_min_full[idx] = arr_f.min()
                    sub_wmean_full[idx] = np.average(arr_f, weights=w_arr)
                    sub_mean_ew[idx] = arr_e.mean()
                    sub_max_ew[idx] = arr_e.max()
                    sub_min_ew[idx] = arr_e.min()
                    sub_known[idx] = known
                    sub_avg_count[idx] = total_count / known

            row = Xhash[idx]
            ids = set(row.indices)
            if ids:
                w_scores_full = []
                w_scores_ew = []
                w_known = 0
                for wid in ids:
                    st = word_stats.get(wid)
                    if st is None:
                        continue
                    w_known += 1
                    if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                        decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                    else:
                        decay = 1.0
                    cur_es = st["ew_sum"] * decay
                    cur_ec = st["ew_count"] * decay
                    rate_full = (st["sum"] + smoothing * prior) / (
                        st["count"] + smoothing
                    )
                    rate_ew = (cur_es + smoothing * prior) / (cur_ec + smoothing)
                    w_scores_full.append(rate_full)
                    w_scores_ew.append(rate_ew)

                if w_scores_full:
                    wf = np.array(w_scores_full, dtype=float)
                    we = np.array(w_scores_ew, dtype=float)
                    word_mean_full[idx] = wf.mean()
                    word_max_full[idx] = wf.max()
                    word_min_full[idx] = wf.min()
                    word_mean_ew[idx] = we.mean()
                    word_max_ew[idx] = we.max()
                    word_min_ew[idx] = we.min()
                    word_known[idx] = w_known

        for idx in group:
            if not update_mask[idx]:
                continue
            yv = float(y[idx])
            for s in set(sub_lists[idx]):
                st = sub_stats.get(s)
                if st is None:
                    st = {
                        "sum": 0.0,
                        "count": 0,
                        "last": t,
                        "ew_sum": 0.0,
                        "ew_count": 0.0,
                    }
                    sub_stats[s] = st
                if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                    decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                else:
                    decay = 1.0
                st["ew_sum"] = st["ew_sum"] * decay + yv
                st["ew_count"] = st["ew_count"] * decay + 1.0
                st["sum"] += yv
                st["count"] += 1
                st["last"] = t

            row = Xhash[idx]
            for wid in set(row.indices):
                st = word_stats.get(wid)
                if st is None:
                    st = {
                        "sum": 0.0,
                        "count": 0,
                        "last": t,
                        "ew_sum": 0.0,
                        "ew_count": 0.0,
                    }
                    word_stats[wid] = st
                if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                    decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                else:
                    decay = 1.0
                st["ew_sum"] = st["ew_sum"] * decay + yv
                st["ew_count"] = st["ew_count"] * decay + 1.0
                st["sum"] += yv
                st["count"] += 1
                st["last"] = t

    mat = np.column_stack(
        [
            sub_mean_full,
            sub_max_full,
            sub_min_full,
            sub_wmean_full,
            sub_mean_ew,
            sub_max_ew,
            sub_min_ew,
            sub_known,
            sub_avg_count,
            word_mean_full,
            word_max_full,
            word_min_full,
            word_mean_ew,
            word_max_ew,
            word_min_ew,
            word_known,
        ]
    )
    return mat


def fit_nb_weights(texts, y, hv, alpha=1.0):
    X = hv.transform(texts)
    pos_counts = np.asarray(X[y == 1].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    neg_counts = np.asarray(X[y == 0].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    w = np.log((pos_counts + alpha) / (neg_counts + alpha))
    return w


def transform_nb(texts, hv, w):
    X = hv.transform(texts)
    X = X.copy()
    X.data *= w[X.indices]
    return normalize(X, norm="l2")


def nb_summary(X_nb):
    total = np.asarray(X_nb.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    abs_total = np.asarray(abs(X_nb).sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    return total, abs_total


def build_group_matrices(base_mat, temp, svd_text, svd_sub, nb, meta_idx, text_idx):
    base_mat = np.asarray(base_mat, dtype=np.float64)
    temp = np.asarray(temp, dtype=np.float64)
    svd_text = np.asarray(svd_text, dtype=np.float64)
    svd_sub = np.asarray(svd_sub, dtype=np.float64)
    nb = np.asarray(nb, dtype=np.float64)

    all_mat = np.hstack([base_mat, temp, svd_text, svd_sub, nb])
    text_mat = np.hstack([base_mat[:, text_idx], svd_text])
    meta_mat = np.hstack([base_mat[:, meta_idx], temp])
    submeta_mat = np.hstack([base_mat[:, meta_idx], svd_sub, temp])

    return all_mat, text_mat, meta_mat, submeta_mat


def optimize_rank_weights(oof_rank, y, iters=40):
    m = oof_rank.shape[1]
    best_w = np.ones(m) / m
    best_auc = roc_auc_score(y, oof_rank @ best_w)

    for restart in range(3):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED + restart)
        w = rng.dirichlet(np.ones(m))
        auc = roc_auc_score(y, oof_rank @ w)
        if auc > best_auc + 1e-6:
            best_auc = auc
            best_w = w.copy()
        else:
            w = best_w.copy()

        for _ in range(iters):
            improved = False
            for j in range(m):
                for step in (0.05, 0.02):
                    w_new = w.copy()
                    w_new[j] += step
                    w_new /= w_new.sum()
                    auc_new = roc_auc_score(y, oof_rank @ w_new)
                    if auc_new > best_auc + 1e-6:
                        best_auc = auc_new
                        best_w = w_new
                        w = w_new
                        improved = True
            if not improved:
                break

    return best_w, best_auc


def bagged_rank_stack(oof_rank, test_rank, y, n_bags=15, C=1.0, seed=SEED):
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=seed + 999)
    inner_oof = np.zeros(len(y))
    test_pred = np.zeros(test_rank.shape[0])
    n_splits = skf.get_n_splits()

    for tr_in, va_in in skf.split(oof_rank, y):
        clfs = []
        pos_idx = tr_in[y[tr_in] == 1]
        neg_idx = tr_in[y[tr_in] == 0]
        for b in range(n_bags):
            rng = np.random.default_rng(seed + 1000 + b)
            if len(pos_idx) > 0 and len(neg_idx) > 0:
                idx_pos = rng.choice(pos_idx, size=len(pos_idx), replace=True)
                idx_neg = rng.choice(neg_idx, size=len(neg_idx), replace=True)
                idx = np.concatenate([idx_pos, idx_neg])
            else:
                idx = tr_in
            clf = LogisticRegression(C=C, solver="liblinear", max_iter=1000)
            clf.fit(oof_rank[idx], y[idx])
            clfs.append(clf)

        pred_va = np.mean(
            [clf.predict_proba(oof_rank[va_in])[:, 1] for clf in clfs], axis=0
        )
        inner_oof[va_in] = pred_va
        test_pred += (
            np.mean([clf.predict_proba(test_rank)[:, 1] for clf in clfs], axis=0)
            / n_splits
        )

    return inner_oof, test_pred

def to_list(x):
    if x is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(x, np.ndarray):
        x = x.tolist()
    if isinstance(x, list):
        return [s for s in x if isinstance(s, str) and s]
    if isinstance(x, str):
        s = x.strip()
        if not s or s.lower() == "nan":
            return []
        try:
            v = json.loads(s)
            if isinstance(v, list):
                return [item for item in v if isinstance(item, str) and item]
        except Exception:
            pass
        return [x]
    return []


def unique_ratio_from_text(s):
    words = str(s).split()
    if not words:
        return 0.0
    return len(set(words)) / (len(words) + 1.0)


def build_base_features(df):
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)

    def num(col):
        if col not in df.columns:
            return pd.Series(0, index=df.index)
        return pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce").fillna(0)

    out["account_age"] = num("requester_account_age_in_days_at_request")
    out["days_since_raop"] = num("requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request")
    out["num_comments"] = num("requester_number_of_comments_at_request")
    out["num_comments_raop"] = num("requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request")
    out["num_posts"] = num("requester_number_of_posts_at_request")
    out["num_posts_raop"] = num("requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request")
    out["num_subreddits"] = num("requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request")
    out["up_minus"] = num("requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request")
    out["up_plus"] = num("requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request")

    out["comment_ratio"] = out["num_comments_raop"] / (out["num_comments"] + 1)
    out["post_ratio"] = out["num_posts_raop"] / (out["num_posts"] + 1)
    out["up_minus_ratio"] = out["up_minus"] / (out["up_plus"].abs() + 1)

    out["log_account_age"] = np.log1p(out["account_age"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_days_raop"] = np.log1p(out["days_since_raop"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_comments"] = np.log1p(out["num_comments"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_comments_raop"] = np.log1p(out["num_comments_raop"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_posts"] = np.log1p(out["num_posts"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_posts_raop"] = np.log1p(out["num_posts_raop"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_subreddits"] = np.log1p(out["num_subreddits"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_up_plus"] = np.log1p(out["up_plus"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_up_minus"] = np.sign(out["up_minus"]) * np.log1p(np.abs(out["up_minus"]))

    utc = num("unix_timestamp_of_request_utc")
    local = num("unix_timestamp_of_request")
    ts = utc.where(utc > 0, local).where(local > 0, utc)
    ts = ts.fillna(0).astype(float)
    out["_ts"] = ts

    ts_for_dt = utc.where(utc > 0, local).where(local > 0, utc)
    dt = pd.to_datetime(ts_for_dt, unit="s", errors="coerce")
    out["year"] = dt.dt.year.fillna(0)
    out["month"] = dt.dt.month.fillna(0)
    out["day"] = dt.dt.day.fillna(0)
    out["weekday"] = dt.dt.weekday.fillna(0)
    out["hour_utc"] = dt.dt.hour.fillna(0)
    out["is_weekend"] = out["weekday"].isin([5, 6]).astype(int)

    tz_diff = (
        ((utc - local) / 3600.0).where((utc > 0) & (local > 0), 0).mod(24).fillna(0)
    )
    out["tz_diff"] = tz_diff

    local_ts = local.where(local > 0, utc)
    local_dt = pd.to_datetime(local_ts, unit="s", errors="coerce")
    out["hour_local"] = local_dt.dt.hour.fillna(0)

    out["hour_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * out["hour_local"] / 24.0)
    out["hour_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * out["hour_local"] / 24.0)
    out["weekday_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * out["weekday"] / 7.0)
    out["weekday_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * out["weekday"] / 7.0)

    body = (
        df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").astype(str)
        if "request_text_edit_aware" in df.columns
        else pd.Series("", index=df.index)
    )
    title = (
        df["request_title"].fillna("").astype(str)
        if "request_title" in df.columns
        else pd.Series("", index=df.index)
    )
    body = body.replace("nan", "", regex=False).replace("None", "", regex=False)
    title = title.replace("nan", "", regex=False).replace("None", "", regex=False)
    text = body.str.strip() + " " + title.str.strip()
    lower_text = text.str.lower()

    out["text_len"] = text.str.len()
    out["word_len"] = text.str.split().str.len().fillna(0)
    out["avg_word_len"] = out["text_len"] / (out["word_len"] + 1)
    out["num_sentences"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]+")
    out["num_question"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    out["num_exclam"] = text.str.count(r"!")
    out["num_period"] = text.str.count(r"\.")
    out["num_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    out["upper_ratio"] = out["num_upper"] / (out["text_len"] + 1)
    out["punct_count"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    out["punct_ratio"] = out["punct_count"] / (out["text_len"] + 1)

    out["title_len"] = title.str.len()
    out["title_words"] = title.str.split().str.len().fillna(0)
    out["title_question"] = title.str.count(r"\?")
    out["title_exclam"] = title.str.count(r"!")
    out["body_len"] = body.str.len()
    out["body_words"] = body.str.split().str.len().fillna(0)
    out["body_avg_word_len"] = out["body_len"] / (out["body_words"] + 1)
    out["body_newlines"] = body.str.count("\n")
    out["body_paragraphs"] = body.str.split("\n\n").str.len().fillna(1)
    out["body_has_url"] = body.str.contains("http", regex=False).astype(int)
    out["body_has_imgur"] = lower_text.str.contains("imgur", regex=False).astype(int)

    out["money_count"] = lower_text.str.count(r"\$")
    out["has_financial"] = lower_text.str.contains(

def add_time_context(base, all_ts):
    ts = base["_ts"].values.astype(float)
    all_ts = np.asarray(all_ts, dtype=float)
    all_ts = np.sort(all_ts[all_ts > 0])

    if len(all_ts) == 0:
        base["days_since_start"] = 0.0
        base["requests_before"] = 0.0
        base["prev_7d"] = 0.0
        base["prev_30d"] = 0.0
        base["log_requests_before"] = 0.0
        base["log_prev_7d"] = 0.0
        base["log_prev_30d"] = 0.0
        return base

    day = 86400.0
    min_ts = all_ts.min()

    base["days_since_start"] = np.where(ts > 0, (ts - min_ts) / day, 0.0)
    idx = np.searchsorted(all_ts, ts, side="left")
    base["requests_before"] = idx
    base["prev_7d"] = idx - np.searchsorted(all_ts, ts - 7 * day, side="left")
    base["prev_30d"] = idx - np.searchsorted(all_ts, ts - 30 * day, side="left")
    base["log_requests_before"] = np.log1p(base["requests_before"])
    base["log_prev_7d"] = np.log1p(base["prev_7d"])
    base["log_prev_30d"] = np.log1p(base["prev_30d"])
    return base


def rolling_global_features(ts, y, update_mask):
    ts = np.asarray(ts, dtype=float)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=float)
    update_mask = np.asarray(update_mask, dtype=bool)

    n = len(ts)
    feat = np.zeros((n, 14))

    labeled_idx = np.where(update_mask)[0]
    if len(labeled_idx) == 0:
        return feat

    order = labeled_idx[np.argsort(ts[labeled_idx], kind="mergesort")]
    sts = ts[order]
    sy = y[order]
    cs = np.cumsum(sy)
    prior = float(np.mean(sy))

    k = np.searchsorted(sts, ts, side="left")

    cnt = k.astype(float)
    s = np.zeros(n)
    idx = k > 0
    s[idx] = cs[k[idx] - 1]
    rate = np.where(cnt > 0, s / np.maximum(cnt, 1), prior)
    feat[:, 0] = cnt
    feat[:, 1] = rate

    l = np.maximum(k - 100, 0)
    cnt100 = (k - l).astype(float)
    s100 = np.zeros(n)
    idx = k > 0
    s100[idx] = cs[k[idx] - 1]
    lidx = l > 0
    s100[lidx] -= cs[l[lidx] - 1]
    rate100 = np.where(cnt100 > 0, s100 / np.maximum(cnt100, 1), prior)
    feat[:, 8] = cnt100
    feat[:, 9] = rate100

    for wi, (window, col_count, col_rate, log_col) in enumerate(
        [
            (7 * 86400.0, 2, 3, 11),
            (30 * 86400.0, 4, 5, 12),
            (90 * 86400.0, 6, 7, 13),
        ]
    ):
        lw = np.searchsorted(sts, ts - window, side="left")
        cntw = (k - lw).astype(float)
        sw = np.zeros(n)
        idx = k > 0
        sw[idx] = cs[k[idx] - 1]
        lidx = lw > 0
        sw[lidx] -= cs[l[lidx] - 1]
        ratew = np.where(cntw > 0, sw / np.maximum(cntw, 1), prior)
        feat[:, col_count] = cntw
        feat[:, col_rate] = ratew

    feat[:, 10] = np.log1p(feat[:, 0])
    feat[:, 11] = np.log1p(feat[:, 2])
    feat[:, 12] = np.log1p(feat[:, 4])
    feat[:, 13] = np.log1p(feat[:, 6])

    return feat


def compute_temporal_features(
    texts,
    sub_lists,
    ts,
    y,
    update_mask,
    word_vec,
    smoothing=10.0,
    half_life=180 * 86400.0,
):
    n = len(texts)
    ts = np.asarray(ts, dtype=float)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=float)
    update_mask = np.asarray(update_mask, dtype=bool)

    prior = float(np.mean(y[update_mask])) if update_mask.any() else 0.0

    Xhash = word_vec.transform(texts).tocsr()

    sub_stats = {}
    word_stats = {}

    sub_mean_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_max_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_min_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_wmean_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_mean_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_max_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_min_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_known = np.zeros(n)
    sub_avg_count = np.zeros(n)

    word_mean_full = np.full(n, prior)
    word_max_full = np.full(n, prior)
    word_min_full = np.full(n, prior)
    word_mean_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    word_max_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    word_min_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    word_known = np.zeros(n)

    sort_idx = np.argsort(ts, kind="mergesort")
    sorted_ts = ts[sort_idx]
    unique_ts, first_pos = np.unique(sorted_ts, return_index=True)

    for gi, t in enumerate(unique_ts):
        start = first_pos[gi]
        end = first_pos[gi + 1] if gi + 1 < len(first_pos) else n
        group = sort_idx[start:end]

        for idx in group:
            subs = sub_lists[idx]
            if subs:
                scores_full = []
                scores_ew = []
                weights = []
                known = 0
                total_count = 0

                for s in set(subs):
                    st = sub_stats.get(s)
                    if st is None:
                        continue
                    known += 1
                    if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                        decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                    else:
                        decay = 1.0
                    cur_es = st["ew_sum"] * decay
                    cur_ec = st["ew_count"] * decay
                    rate_full = (st["sum"] + smoothing * prior) / (
                        st["count"] + smoothing
                    )
                    rate_ew = (cur_es + smoothing * prior) / (cur_ec + smoothing)
                    scores_full.append(rate_full)
                    scores_ew.append(rate_ew)
                    w = max(st["count"], 1.0)
                    weights.append(w)
                    total_count += st["count"]

                if scores_full:
                    arr_f = np.array(scores_full, dtype=float)
                    arr_e = np.array(scores_ew, dtype=float)
                    w_arr = np.array(weights, dtype=float)
                    sub_mean_full[idx] = arr_f.mean()
                    sub_max_full[idx] = arr_f.max()
                    sub_min_full[idx] = arr_f.min()
                    sub_wmean_full[idx] = np.average(arr_f, weights=w_arr)
                    sub_mean_ew[idx] = arr_e.mean()
                    sub_max_ew[idx] = arr_e.max()
                    sub_min_ew[idx] = arr_e.min()
                    sub_known[idx] = known
                    sub_avg_count[idx] = total_count / known

            row = Xhash[idx]
            ids = set(row.indices)
            if ids:
                w_scores_full = []
                w_scores_ew = []
                w_known = 0
                for wid in ids:
                    st = word_stats.get(wid)
                    if st is None:
                        continue
                    w_known += 1
                    if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                        decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                    else:
                        decay = 1.0
                    cur_es = st["ew_sum"] * decay
                    cur_ec = st["ew_count"] * decay
                    rate_full = (st["sum"] + smoothing * prior) / (
                        st["count"] + smoothing
                    )
                    rate_ew = (cur_es + smoothing * prior) / (cur_ec + smoothing)
                    w_scores_full.append(rate_full)
                    w_scores_ew.append(rate_ew)

                if w_scores_full:
                    wf = np.array(w_scores_full, dtype=float)
                    we = np.array(w_scores_ew, dtype=float)
                    word_mean_full[idx] = wf.mean()
                    word_max_full[idx] = wf.max()
                    word_min_full[idx] = wf.min()
                    word_mean_ew[idx] = we.mean()
                    word_max_ew[idx] = we.max()
                    word_min_ew[idx] = we.min()
                    word_known[idx] = w_known

        for idx in group:
            if not update_mask[idx]:
                continue
            yv = float(y[idx])
            for s in set(sub_lists[idx]):
                st = sub_stats.get(s)
                if st is None:
                    st = {
                        "sum": 0.0,
                        "count": 0,
                        "last": t,
                        "ew_sum": 0.0,
                        "ew_count": 0.0,
                    }
                    sub_stats[s] = st
                if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                    decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                else:
                    decay = 1.0
                st["ew_sum"] = st["ew_sum"] * decay + yv
                st["ew_count"] = st["ew_count"] * decay + 1.0
                st["sum"] += yv
                st["count"] += 1
                st["last"] = t

            row = Xhash[idx]
            for wid in set(row.indices):
                st = word_stats.get(wid)
                if st is None:
                    st = {
                        "sum": 0.0,
                        "count": 0,
                        "last": t,
                        "ew_sum": 0.0,
                        "ew_count": 0.0,
                    }
                    word_stats[wid] = st
                if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                    decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                else:
                    decay = 1.0
                st["ew_sum"] = st["ew_sum"] * decay + yv
                st["ew_count"] = st["ew_count"] * decay + 1.0
                st["sum"] += yv
                st["count"] += 1
                st["last"] = t

    mat = np.column_stack(
        [
            sub_mean_full,
            sub_max_full,
            sub_min_full,
            sub_wmean_full,
            sub_mean_ew,
            sub_max_ew,
            sub_min_ew,
            sub_known,
            sub_avg_count,
            word_mean_full,
            word_max_full,
            word_min_full,
            word_mean_ew,
            word_max_ew,
            word_min_ew,
            word_known,
        ]
    )
    return mat


def fit_nb_weights(texts, y, hv, alpha=1.0):
    X = hv.transform(texts)
    pos_counts = np.asarray(X[y == 1].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    neg_counts = np.asarray(X[y == 0].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    w = np.log((pos_counts + alpha) / (neg_counts + alpha))
    return w


def transform_nb(texts, hv, w):
    X = hv.transform(texts)
    X = X.copy()
    X.data *= w[X.indices]
    return normalize(X, norm="l2")


def nb_summary(X_nb):
    total = np.asarray(X_nb.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    abs_total = np.asarray(abs(X_nb).sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    return total, abs_total


def build_group_matrices(base_mat, temp, svd_text, svd_sub, nb, meta_idx, text_idx):
    base_mat = np.asarray(base_mat, dtype=np.float64)
    temp = np.asarray(temp, dtype=np.float64)
    svd_text = np.asarray(svd_text, dtype=np.float64)
    svd_sub = np.asarray(svd_sub, dtype=np.float64)
    nb = np.asarray(nb, dtype=np.float64)

    all_mat = np.hstack([base_mat, temp, svd_text, svd_sub, nb])
    text_mat = np.hstack([base_mat[:, text_idx], svd_text])
    meta_mat = np.hstack([base_mat[:, meta_idx], temp])
    submeta_mat = np.hstack([base_mat[:, meta_idx], svd_sub, temp])

    return all_mat, text_mat, meta_mat, submeta_mat


def optimize_rank_weights(oof_rank, y, iters=40):
    m = oof_rank.shape[1]
    best_w = np.ones(m) / m
    best_auc = roc_auc_score(y, oof_rank @ best_w)

    for restart in range(3):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED + restart)
        w = rng.dirichlet(np.ones(m))
        auc = roc_auc_score(y, oof_rank @ w)
        if auc > best_auc + 1e-6:
            best_auc = auc
            best_w = w.copy()
        else:
            w = best_w.copy()

        for _ in range(iters):
            improved = False
            for j in range(m):
                for step in (0.05, 0.02):
                    w_new = w.copy()
                    w_new[j] += step
                    w_new /= w_new.sum()
                    auc_new = roc_auc_score(y, oof_rank @ w_new)
                    if auc_new > best_auc + 1e-6:
                        best_auc = auc_new
                        best_w = w_new
                        w = w_new
                        improved = True
            if not improved:
                break

    return best_w, best_auc


def bagged_rank_stack(oof_rank, test_rank, y, n_bags=15, C=1.0, seed=SEED):
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=seed + 999)
    inner_oof = np.zeros(len(y))
    test_pred = np.zeros(test_rank.shape[0])
    n_splits = skf.get_n_splits()

    for tr_in, va_in in skf.split(oof_rank, y):
        clfs = []
        pos_idx = tr_in[y[tr_in] == 1]
        neg_idx = tr_in[y[tr_in] == 0]
        for b in range(n_bags):
            rng = np.random.default_rng(seed + 1000 + b)
            if len(pos_idx) > 0 and len(neg_idx) > 0:
                idx_pos = rng.choice(pos_idx, size=len(pos_idx), replace=True)
                idx_neg = rng.choice(neg_idx, size=len(neg_idx), replace=True)
                idx = np.concatenate([idx_pos, idx_neg])
            else:
                idx = tr_in
            clf = LogisticRegression(C=C, solver="liblinear", max_iter=1000)
            clf.fit(oof_rank[idx], y[idx])
            clfs.append(clf)

        pred_va = np.mean(
            [clf.predict_proba(oof_rank[va_in])[:, 1] for clf in clfs], axis=0
        )
        inner_oof[va_in] = pred_va
        test_pred += (
            np.mean([clf.predict_proba(test_rank)[:, 1] for clf in clfs], axis=0)
            / n_splits
        )

    return inner_oof, test_pred

def to_list(x):
    if x is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(x, np.ndarray):
        x = x.tolist()
    if isinstance(x, list):
        return [s for s in x if isinstance(s, str) and s]
    if isinstance(x, str):
        s = x.strip()
        if not s or s.lower() == "nan":
            return []
        try:
            v = json.loads(s)
            if isinstance(v, list):
                return [item for item in v if isinstance(item, str) and item]
        except Exception:
            pass
        return [x]
    return []


def unique_ratio_from_text(s):

    return len(set(words)) / (len(words) + 1.0)

def add_time_context(base, all_ts):
    ts = base["_ts"].values.astype(float)
    all_ts = np.asarray(all_ts, dtype=float)
    all_ts = np.sort(all_ts[all_ts > 0])

    if len(all_ts) == 0:
        base["days_since_start"] = 0.0
        base["requests_before"] = 0.0
        base["prev_7d"] = 0.0
        base["prev_30d"] = 0.0
        base["log_requests_before"] = 0.0
        base["log_prev_7d"] = 0.0
        base["log_prev_30d"] = 0.0
        return base

    day = 86400.0
    min_ts = all_ts.min()

    base["days_since_start"] = np.where(ts > 0, (ts - min_ts) / day, 0.0)
    idx = np.searchsorted(all_ts, ts, side="left")
    base["requests_before"] = idx
    base["prev_7d"] = idx - np.searchsorted(all_ts, ts - 7 * day, side="left")
    base["prev_30d"] = idx - np.searchsorted(all_ts, ts - 30 * day, side="left")
    base["log_requests_before"] = np.log1p(base["requests_before"])
    base["log_prev_7d"] = np.log1p(base["prev_7d"])
    base["log_prev_30d"] = np.log1p(base["prev_30d"])
    return base


def rolling_global_features(ts, y, update_mask):
    ts = np.asarray(ts, dtype=float)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=float)
    update_mask = np.asarray(update_mask, dtype=bool)

    n = len(ts)
    feat = np.zeros((n, 14))

    labeled_idx = np.where(update_mask)[0]
    if len(labeled_idx) == 0:
        return feat

    order = labeled_idx[np.argsort(ts[labeled_idx], kind="mergesort")]
    sts = ts[order]
    sy = y[order]
    cs = np.cumsum(sy)
    prior = float(np.mean(sy))

    k = np.searchsorted(sts, ts, side="left")

    cnt = k.astype(float)
    s = np.zeros(n)
    idx = k > 0
    s[idx] = cs[k[idx] - 1]
    rate = np.where(cnt > 0, s / np.maximum(cnt, 1), prior)
    feat[:, 0] = cnt
    feat[:, 1] = rate

    l = np.maximum(k - 100, 0)
    cnt100 = (k - l).astype(float)
    s100 = np.zeros(n)
    idx = k > 0
    s100[idx] = cs[k[idx] - 1]
    lidx = l > 0
    s100[lidx] -= cs[l[lidx] - 1]
    rate100 = np.where(cnt100 > 0, s100 / np.maximum(cnt100, 1), prior)
    feat[:, 8] = cnt100
    feat[:, 9] = rate100

    for wi, (window, col_count, col_rate, log_col) in enumerate(
        [
            (7 * 86400.0, 2, 3, 11),
            (30 * 86400.0, 4, 5, 12),
            (90 * 86400.0, 6, 7, 13),
        ]
    ):
        lw = np.searchsorted(sts, ts - window, side="left")
        cntw = (k - lw).astype(float)
        sw = np.zeros(n)
        idx = k > 0
        sw[idx] = cs[k[idx] - 1]
        lidx = lw > 0
        sw[lidx] -= cs[l[lidx] - 1]
        ratew = np.where(cntw > 0, sw / np.maximum(cntw, 1), prior)
        feat[:, col_count] = cntw
        feat[:, col_rate] = ratew

    feat[:, 10] = np.log1p(feat[:, 0])
    feat[:, 11] = np.log1p(feat[:, 2])
    feat[:, 12] = np.log1p(feat[:, 4])
    feat[:, 13] = np.log1p(feat[:, 6])

    return feat


def compute_temporal_features(
    texts,
    sub_lists,
    ts,
    y,
    update_mask,
    word_vec,
    smoothing=10.0,
    half_life=180 * 86400.0,
):
    n = len(texts)
    ts = np.asarray(ts, dtype=float)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=float)
    update_mask = np.asarray(update_mask, dtype=bool)

    prior = float(np.mean(y[update_mask])) if update_mask.any() else 0.0

    Xhash = word_vec.transform(texts).tocsr()

    sub_stats = {}
    word_stats = {}

    sub_mean_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_max_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_min_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_wmean_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_mean_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_max_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_min_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_known = np.zeros(n)
    sub_avg_count = np.zeros(n)

    word_mean_full = np.full(n, prior)
    word_max_full = np.full(n, prior)
    word_min_full = np.full(n, prior)
    word_mean_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    word_max_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    word_min_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    word_known = np.zeros(n)

    sort_idx = np.argsort(ts, kind="mergesort")
    sorted_ts = ts[sort_idx]
    unique_ts, first_pos = np.unique(sorted_ts, return_index=True)

    for gi, t in enumerate(unique_ts):
        start = first_pos[gi]
        end = first_pos[gi + 1] if gi + 1 < len(first_pos) else n
        group = sort_idx[start:end]

        for idx in group:
            subs = sub_lists[idx]
            if subs:
                scores_full = []
                scores_ew = []
                weights = []
                known = 0
                total_count = 0

                for s in set(subs):
                    st = sub_stats.get(s)
                    if st is None:
                        continue
                    known += 1
                    if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                        decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                    else:
                        decay = 1.0
                    cur_es = st["ew_sum"] * decay
                    cur_ec = st["ew_count"] * decay
                    rate_full = (st["sum"] + smoothing * prior) / (
                        st["count"] + smoothing
                    )
                    rate_ew = (cur_es + smoothing * prior) / (cur_ec + smoothing)
                    scores_full.append(rate_full)
                    scores_ew.append(rate_ew)
                    w = max(st["count"], 1.0)
                    weights.append(w)
                    total_count += st["count"]

                if scores_full:
                    arr_f = np.array(scores_full, dtype=float)
                    arr_e = np.array(scores_ew, dtype=float)
                    w_arr = np.array(weights, dtype=float)
                    sub_mean_full[idx] = arr_f.mean()
                    sub_max_full[idx] = arr_f.max()
                    sub_min_full[idx] = arr_f.min()
                    sub_wmean_full[idx] = np.average(arr_f, weights=w_arr)
                    sub_mean_ew[idx] = arr_e.mean()
                    sub_max_ew[idx] = arr_e.max()
                    sub_min_ew[idx] = arr_e.min()
                    sub_known[idx] = known
                    sub_avg_count[idx] = total_count / known

            row = Xhash[idx]
            ids = set(row.indices)
            if ids:
                w_scores_full = []
                w_scores_ew = []
                w_known = 0
                for wid in ids:
                    st = word_stats.get(wid)
                    if st is None:
                        continue
                    w_known += 1
                    if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                        decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                    else:
                        decay = 1.0
                    cur_es = st["ew_sum"] * decay
                    cur_ec = st["ew_count"] * decay
                    rate_full = (st["sum"] + smoothing * prior) / (
                        st["count"] + smoothing
                    )
                    rate_ew = (cur_es + smoothing * prior) / (cur_ec + smoothing)
                    w_scores_full.append(rate_full)
                    w_scores_ew.append(rate_ew)

                if w_scores_full:
                    wf = np.array(w_scores_full, dtype=float)
                    we = np.array(w_scores_ew, dtype=float)
                    word_mean_full[idx] = wf.mean()
                    word_max_full[idx] = wf.max()
                    word_min_full[idx] = wf.min()
                    word_mean_ew[idx] = we.mean()
                    word_max_ew[idx] = we.max()
                    word_min_ew[idx] = we.min()
                    word_known[idx] = w_known

        for idx in group:
            if not update_mask[idx]:
                continue
            yv = float(y[idx])
            for s in set(sub_lists[idx]):
                st = sub_stats.get(s)
                if st is None:
                    st = {
                        "sum": 0.0,
                        "count": 0,
                        "last": t,
                        "ew_sum": 0.0,
                        "ew_count": 0.0,
                    }
                    sub_stats[s] = st
                if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                    decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                else:
                    decay = 1.0
                st["ew_sum"] = st["ew_sum"] * decay + yv
                st["ew_count"] = st["ew_count"] * decay + 1.0
                st["sum"] += yv
                st["count"] += 1
                st["last"] = t

            row = Xhash[idx]
            for wid in set(row.indices):
                st = word_stats.get(wid)
                if st is None:
                    st = {
                        "sum": 0.0,
                        "count": 0,
                        "last": t,
                        "ew_sum": 0.0,
                        "ew_count": 0.0,
                    }
                    word_stats[wid] = st
                if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                    decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                else:
                    decay = 1.0
                st["ew_sum"] = st["ew_sum"] * decay + yv
                st["ew_count"] = st["ew_count"] * decay + 1.0
                st["sum"] += yv
                st["count"] += 1
                st["last"] = t

    mat = np.column_stack(
        [
            sub_mean_full,
            sub_max_full,
            sub_min_full,
            sub_wmean_full,
            sub_mean_ew,
            sub_max_ew,
            sub_min_ew,
            sub_known,
            sub_avg_count,
            word_mean_full,
            word_max_full,
            word_min_full,
            word_mean_ew,
            word_max_ew,
            word_min_ew,
            word_known,
        ]
    )
    return mat


def fit_nb_weights(texts, y, hv, alpha=1.0):
    X = hv.transform(texts)
    pos_counts = np.asarray(X[y == 1].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    neg_counts = np.asarray(X[y == 0].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    w = np.log((pos_counts + alpha) / (neg_counts + alpha))
    return w


def transform_nb(texts, hv, w):
    X = hv.transform(texts)
    X = X.copy()
    X.data *= w[X.indices]
    return normalize(X, norm="l2")


def nb_summary(X_nb):
    total = np.asarray(X_nb.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    abs_total = np.asarray(abs(X_nb).sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    return total, abs_total


def build_group_matrices(base_mat, temp, svd_text, svd_sub, nb, meta_idx, text_idx):
    base_mat = np.asarray(base_mat, dtype=np.float64)
    temp = np.asarray(temp, dtype=np.float64)
    svd_text = np.asarray(svd_text, dtype=np.float64)
    svd_sub = np.asarray(svd_sub, dtype=np.float64)
    nb = np.asarray(nb, dtype=np.float64)

    all_mat = np.hstack([base_mat, temp, svd_text, svd_sub, nb])
    text_mat = np.hstack([base_mat[:, text_idx], svd_text])
    meta_mat = np.hstack([base_mat[:, meta_idx], temp])
    submeta_mat = np.hstack([base_mat[:, meta_idx], svd_sub, temp])

    return all_mat, text_mat, meta_mat, submeta_mat


def optimize_rank_weights(oof_rank, y, iters=40):
    m = oof_rank.shape[1]
    best_w = np.ones(m) / m
    best_auc = roc_auc_score(y, oof_rank @ best_w)

    for restart in range(3):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED + restart)
        w = rng.dirichlet(np.ones(m))
        auc = roc_auc_score(y, oof_rank @ w)
        if auc > best_auc + 1e-6:
            best_auc = auc
            best_w = w.copy()
        else:
            w = best_w.copy()

        for _ in range(iters):
            improved = False
            for j in range(m):
                for step in (0.05, 0.02):
                    w_new = w.copy()
                    w_new[j] += step
                    w_new /= w_new.sum()
                    auc_new = roc_auc_score(y, oof_rank @ w_new)
                    if auc_new > best_auc + 1e-6:
                        best_auc = auc_new
                        best_w = w_new
                        w = w_new
                        improved = True
            if not improved:
                break

    return best_w, best_auc


def bagged_rank_stack(oof_rank, test_rank, y, n_bags=15, C=1.0, seed=SEED):
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=seed + 999)
    inner_oof = np.zeros(len(y))
    test_pred = np.zeros(test_rank.shape[0])
    n_splits = skf.get_n_splits()

    for tr_in, va_in in skf.split(oof_rank, y):
        clfs = []
        pos_idx = tr_in[y[tr_in] == 1]
        neg_idx = tr_in[y[tr_in] == 0]
        for b in range(n_bags):
            rng = np.random.default_rng(seed + 1000 + b)
            if len(pos_idx) > 0 and len(neg_idx) > 0:
                idx_pos = rng.choice(pos_idx, size=len(pos_idx), replace=True)
                idx_neg = rng.choice(neg_idx, size=len(neg_idx), replace=True)
                idx = np.concatenate([idx_pos, idx_neg])
            else:
                idx = tr_in
            clf = LogisticRegression(C=C, solver="liblinear", max_iter=1000)
            clf.fit(oof_rank[idx], y[idx])
            clfs.append(clf)

        pred_va = np.mean(
            [clf.predict_proba(oof_rank[va_in])[:, 1] for clf in clfs], axis=0
        )
        inner_oof[va_in] = pred_va
        test_pred += (
            np.mean([__spt_capture__((clf.predict_proba(test_rank)), "predict_proba", "L758C21", "test_rank")[:, 1] for clf in clfs], axis=0)
            / n_splits
        )

    return inner_oof, test_pred

    print(f"Bagged rank stack C={C} CV AUC: {auc_stack:.6f}")

best_name = max(candidates, key=lambda k: candidates[k][0])
final_cv_auc, final_test = candidates[best_name]

print(f"Final selected ensemble: {best_name}")
print(f"Final 5-fold CV AUC: {final_cv_auc:.6f}")

final_test = np.clip(final_test, 0.0, 1.0)

submission = pd.DataFrame(

def to_list(x):
    if x is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(x, np.ndarray):
        x = x.tolist()
    if isinstance(x, list):
        return [s for s in x if isinstance(s, str) and s]
    if isinstance(x, str):
        s = x.strip()
        if not s or s.lower() == "nan":
            return []
        try:
            v = json.loads(s)
            if isinstance(v, list):
                return [item for item in v if isinstance(item, str) and item]
        except Exception:
            pass
        return [x]
    return []

def add_time_context(base, all_ts):
    ts = base["_ts"].values.astype(float)
    all_ts = np.asarray(all_ts, dtype=float)
    all_ts = np.sort(all_ts[all_ts > 0])

    if len(all_ts) == 0:
        base["days_since_start"] = 0.0
        base["requests_before"] = 0.0
        base["prev_7d"] = 0.0
        base["prev_30d"] = 0.0
        base["log_requests_before"] = 0.0
        base["log_prev_7d"] = 0.0
        base["log_prev_30d"] = 0.0
        return base

    day = 86400.0
    min_ts = all_ts.min()

    base["days_since_start"] = np.where(ts > 0, (ts - min_ts) / day, 0.0)
    idx = np.searchsorted(all_ts, ts, side="left")
    base["requests_before"] = idx
    base["prev_7d"] = idx - np.searchsorted(all_ts, ts - 7 * day, side="left")
    base["prev_30d"] = idx - np.searchsorted(all_ts, ts - 30 * day, side="left")
    base["log_requests_before"] = np.log1p(base["requests_before"])
    base["log_prev_7d"] = np.log1p(base["prev_7d"])
    base["log_prev_30d"] = np.log1p(base["prev_30d"])
    return base


def rolling_global_features(ts, y, update_mask):
    ts = np.asarray(ts, dtype=float)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=float)
    update_mask = np.asarray(update_mask, dtype=bool)

    n = len(ts)
    feat = np.zeros((n, 14))

    labeled_idx = np.where(update_mask)[0]
    if len(labeled_idx) == 0:
        return feat

    order = labeled_idx[np.argsort(ts[labeled_idx], kind="mergesort")]
    sts = ts[order]
    sy = y[order]
    cs = np.cumsum(sy)
    prior = float(np.mean(sy))

    k = np.searchsorted(sts, ts, side="left")

    cnt = k.astype(float)
    s = np.zeros(n)
    idx = k > 0
    s[idx] = cs[k[idx] - 1]
    rate = np.where(cnt > 0, s / np.maximum(cnt, 1), prior)
    feat[:, 0] = cnt
    feat[:, 1] = rate

    l = np.maximum(k - 100, 0)
    cnt100 = (k - l).astype(float)
    s100 = np.zeros(n)
    idx = k > 0
    s100[idx] = cs[k[idx] - 1]
    lidx = l > 0
    s100[lidx] -= cs[l[lidx] - 1]
    rate100 = np.where(cnt100 > 0, s100 / np.maximum(cnt100, 1), prior)
    feat[:, 8] = cnt100
    feat[:, 9] = rate100

    for wi, (window, col_count, col_rate, log_col) in enumerate(
        [
            (7 * 86400.0, 2, 3, 11),
            (30 * 86400.0, 4, 5, 12),
            (90 * 86400.0, 6, 7, 13),
        ]
    ):
        lw = np.searchsorted(sts, ts - window, side="left")
        cntw = (k - lw).astype(float)
        sw = np.zeros(n)
        idx = k > 0
        sw[idx] = cs[k[idx] - 1]
        lidx = lw > 0
        sw[lidx] -= cs[l[lidx] - 1]
        ratew = np.where(cntw > 0, sw / np.maximum(cntw, 1), prior)
        feat[:, col_count] = cntw
        feat[:, col_rate] = ratew

    feat[:, 10] = np.log1p(feat[:, 0])
    feat[:, 11] = np.log1p(feat[:, 2])
    feat[:, 12] = np.log1p(feat[:, 4])
    feat[:, 13] = np.log1p(feat[:, 6])

    return feat


def compute_temporal_features(
    texts,
    sub_lists,
    ts,
    y,
    update_mask,
    word_vec,
    smoothing=10.0,
    half_life=180 * 86400.0,
):
    n = len(texts)
    ts = np.asarray(ts, dtype=float)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=float)
    update_mask = np.asarray(update_mask, dtype=bool)

    prior = float(np.mean(y[update_mask])) if update_mask.any() else 0.0

    Xhash = word_vec.transform(texts).tocsr()

    sub_stats = {}
    word_stats = {}

    sub_mean_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_max_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_min_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_wmean_full = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_mean_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_max_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_min_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    sub_known = np.zeros(n)
    sub_avg_count = np.zeros(n)

    word_mean_full = np.full(n, prior)
    word_max_full = np.full(n, prior)
    word_min_full = np.full(n, prior)
    word_mean_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    word_max_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    word_min_ew = np.full(n, prior)
    word_known = np.zeros(n)

    sort_idx = np.argsort(ts, kind="mergesort")
    sorted_ts = ts[sort_idx]
    unique_ts, first_pos = np.unique(sorted_ts, return_index=True)

    for gi, t in enumerate(unique_ts):
        start = first_pos[gi]
        end = first_pos[gi + 1] if gi + 1 < len(first_pos) else n
        group = sort_idx[start:end]

        for idx in group:
            subs = sub_lists[idx]
            if subs:
                scores_full = []
                scores_ew = []
                weights = []
                known = 0
                total_count = 0

                for s in set(subs):
                    st = sub_stats.get(s)
                    if st is None:
                        continue
                    known += 1
                    if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                        decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                    else:
                        decay = 1.0
                    cur_es = st["ew_sum"] * decay
                    cur_ec = st["ew_count"] * decay
                    rate_full = (st["sum"] + smoothing * prior) / (
                        st["count"] + smoothing
                    )
                    rate_ew = (cur_es + smoothing * prior) / (cur_ec + smoothing)
                    scores_full.append(rate_full)
                    scores_ew.append(rate_ew)
                    w = max(st["count"], 1.0)
                    weights.append(w)
                    total_count += st["count"]

                if scores_full:
                    arr_f = np.array(scores_full, dtype=float)
                    arr_e = np.array(scores_ew, dtype=float)
                    w_arr = np.array(weights, dtype=float)
                    sub_mean_full[idx] = arr_f.mean()
                    sub_max_full[idx] = arr_f.max()
                    sub_min_full[idx] = arr_f.min()
                    sub_wmean_full[idx] = np.average(arr_f, weights=w_arr)
                    sub_mean_ew[idx] = arr_e.mean()
                    sub_max_ew[idx] = arr_e.max()
                    sub_min_ew[idx] = arr_e.min()
                    sub_known[idx] = known
                    sub_avg_count[idx] = total_count / known

            row = Xhash[idx]
            ids = set(row.indices)
            if ids:
                w_scores_full = []
                w_scores_ew = []
                w_known = 0
                for wid in ids:
                    st = word_stats.get(wid)
                    if st is None:
                        continue
                    w_known += 1
                    if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                        decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                    else:
                        decay = 1.0
                    cur_es = st["ew_sum"] * decay
                    cur_ec = st["ew_count"] * decay
                    rate_full = (st["sum"] + smoothing * prior) / (
                        st["count"] + smoothing
                    )
                    rate_ew = (cur_es + smoothing * prior) / (cur_ec + smoothing)
                    w_scores_full.append(rate_full)
                    w_scores_ew.append(rate_ew)

                if w_scores_full:
                    wf = np.array(w_scores_full, dtype=float)
                    we = np.array(w_scores_ew, dtype=float)
                    word_mean_full[idx] = wf.mean()
                    word_max_full[idx] = wf.max()
                    word_min_full[idx] = wf.min()
                    word_mean_ew[idx] = we.mean()
                    word_max_ew[idx] = we.max()
                    word_min_ew[idx] = we.min()
                    word_known[idx] = w_known

        for idx in group:
            if not update_mask[idx]:
                continue
            yv = float(y[idx])
            for s in set(sub_lists[idx]):
                st = sub_stats.get(s)
                if st is None:
                    st = {
                        "sum": 0.0,
                        "count": 0,
                        "last": t,
                        "ew_sum": 0.0,
                        "ew_count": 0.0,
                    }
                    sub_stats[s] = st
                if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                    decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                else:
                    decay = 1.0
                st["ew_sum"] = st["ew_sum"] * decay + yv
                st["ew_count"] = st["ew_count"] * decay + 1.0
                st["sum"] += yv
                st["count"] += 1
                st["last"] = t

            row = Xhash[idx]
            for wid in set(row.indices):
                st = word_stats.get(wid)
                if st is None:
                    st = {
                        "sum": 0.0,
                        "count": 0,
                        "last": t,
                        "ew_sum": 0.0,
                        "ew_count": 0.0,
                    }
                    word_stats[wid] = st
                if half_life > 0 and t >= st["last"]:
                    decay = math.exp(-(t - st["last"]) / half_life)
                else:
                    decay = 1.0
                st["ew_sum"] = st["ew_sum"] * decay + yv
                st["ew_count"] = st["ew_count"] * decay + 1.0
                st["sum"] += yv
                st["count"] += 1
                st["last"] = t

    mat = np.column_stack(
        [
            sub_mean_full,
            sub_max_full,
            sub_min_full,
            sub_wmean_full,
            sub_mean_ew,
            sub_max_ew,
            sub_min_ew,
            sub_known,
            sub_avg_count,
            word_mean_full,
            word_max_full,
            word_min_full,
            word_mean_ew,
            word_max_ew,
            word_min_ew,
            word_known,
        ]
    )
    return mat


def fit_nb_weights(texts, y, hv, alpha=1.0):
    X = hv.transform(texts)
    pos_counts = np.asarray(X[y == 1].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    neg_counts = np.asarray(X[y == 0].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    w = np.log((pos_counts + alpha) / (neg_counts + alpha))
    return w


def transform_nb(texts, hv, w):
    X = hv.transform(texts)
    X = X.copy()
    X.data *= w[X.indices]
    return normalize(X, norm="l2")


def nb_summary(X_nb):
    total = np.asarray(X_nb.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    abs_total = np.asarray(abs(X_nb).sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    return total, abs_total


def build_group_matrices(base_mat, temp, svd_text, svd_sub, nb, meta_idx, text_idx):
    base_mat = np.asarray(base_mat, dtype=np.float64)
    temp = np.asarray(temp, dtype=np.float64)
    svd_text = np.asarray(svd_text, dtype=np.float64)
    svd_sub = np.asarray(svd_sub, dtype=np.float64)
    nb = np.asarray(nb, dtype=np.float64)

    all_mat = np.hstack([base_mat, temp, svd_text, svd_sub, nb])
    text_mat = np.hstack([base_mat[:, text_idx], svd_text])
    meta_mat = np.hstack([base_mat[:, meta_idx], temp])
    submeta_mat = np.hstack([base_mat[:, meta_idx], svd_sub, temp])

    return all_mat, text_mat, meta_mat, submeta_mat


def optimize_rank_weights(oof_rank, y, iters=40):
    m = oof_rank.shape[1]
    best_w = np.ones(m) / m
    best_auc = roc_auc_score(y, oof_rank @ best_w)

    for restart in range(3):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED + restart)
        w = rng.dirichlet(np.ones(m))
        auc = roc_auc_score(y, oof_rank @ w)
        if auc > best_auc + 1e-6:
            best_auc = auc
            best_w = w.copy()
        else:
            w = best_w.copy()

        for _ in range(iters):
            improved = False
            for j in range(m):
                for step in (0.05, 0.02):
                    w_new = w.copy()
                    w_new[j] += step
                    w_new /= w_new.sum()
                    auc_new = roc_auc_score(y, oof_rank @ w_new)
                    if auc_new > best_auc + 1e-6:
                        best_auc = auc_new
                        best_w = w_new
                        w = w_new
                        improved = True
            if not improved:
                break

    return best_w, best_auc

def fit_bagged_coord_weights(oof_rank, y, n_bag=5, iters=12):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED + 100)
    wsum = np.zeros(oof_rank.shape[1])
    for _ in range(n_bag):
        idx = rng.choice(len(y), size=int(0.8 * len(y)), replace=False)
        w, _ = optimize_rank_weights(oof_rank[idx], y[idx], iters=iters)
        wsum += w
    return wsum / n_bag

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=2024)

    if strategy == "avg":
        preds = oof_rank.mean(axis=1)
        return preds, roc_auc_score(y, preds)

    for tr, va in skf.split(oof_rank, y):
        if strategy == "coord":
            w, _ = optimize_rank_weights(oof_rank[tr], y[tr], iters=10)
            preds[va] = oof_rank[va] @ w
        elif strategy == "log":
            Xtr = np.hstack([oof_rank[tr], context_meta[tr]])

                n_jobs=-1,
                verbose=-1,
            )
            model.fit(Xtr, y[tr])
            preds[va] = model.predict_proba(Xva)[:, 1]

    return preds, roc_auc_score(y, preds)

def to_list(x):
    if x is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(x, np.ndarray):
        x = x.tolist()
    if isinstance(x, list):
        return [s for s in x if isinstance(s, str) and s]
    if isinstance(x, str):
        s = x.strip()
        if not s or s.lower() == "nan":
            return []
        try:
            v = json.loads(s)
            if isinstance(v, list):
                return [item for item in v if isinstance(item, str) and item]
        except Exception:
            pass
        return [x]
    return []


def build_base_features(df):
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)

    def num(col):
        if col not in df.columns:
            return pd.Series(0, index=df.index)
        return pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce").fillna(0)

    # Request-time metadata
    out["account_age"] = num("requester_account_age_in_days_at_request")
    out["days_since_raop"] = num("requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request")
    out["num_comments"] = num("requester_number_of_comments_at_request")
    out["num_comments_raop"] = num("requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request")
    out["num_posts"] = num("requester_number_of_posts_at_request")
    out["num_posts_raop"] = num("requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request")
    out["num_subreddits"] = num("requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request")
    out["up_minus"] = num("requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request")
    out["up_plus"] = num("requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request")

    # Ratios and log transforms
    out["comment_ratio"] = out["num_comments_raop"] / (out["num_comments"] + 1)
    out["post_ratio"] = out["num_posts_raop"] / (out["num_posts"] + 1)
    out["up_minus_ratio"] = out["up_minus"] / (out["up_plus"].abs() + 1)

    out["log_account_age"] = np.log1p(out["account_age"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_days_raop"] = np.log1p(out["days_since_raop"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_comments"] = np.log1p(out["num_comments"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_comments_raop"] = np.log1p(out["num_comments_raop"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_posts"] = np.log1p(out["num_posts"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_posts_raop"] = np.log1p(out["num_posts_raop"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_subreddits"] = np.log1p(out["num_subreddits"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_up_plus"] = np.log1p(out["up_plus"].clip(lower=0))
    out["log_up_minus"] = np.sign(out["up_minus"]) * np.log1p(np.abs(out["up_minus"]))

    # Time features
    utc = num("unix_timestamp_of_request_utc")
    local = num("unix_timestamp_of_request")
    ts = utc.where(utc > 0, local).where(local > 0, utc)
    ts = ts.fillna(0).astype(float)
    out["_ts"] = ts

    ts_for_dt = utc.where(utc > 0, local).where(local > 0, utc)
    dt = pd.to_datetime(ts_for_dt, unit="s", errors="coerce")
    out["year"] = dt.dt.year.fillna(0)
    out["month"] = dt.dt.month.fillna(0)
    out["day"] = dt.dt.day.fillna(0)
    out["weekday"] = dt.dt.weekday.fillna(0)
    out["hour_utc"] = dt.dt.hour.fillna(0)
    out["is_weekend"] = out["weekday"].isin([5, 6]).astype(int)

    tz_diff = (
        ((utc - local) / 3600.0).where((utc > 0) & (local > 0), 0).mod(24).fillna(0)
    )
    out["tz_diff"] = tz_diff

    local_ts = local.where(local > 0, utc)
    local_dt = pd.to_datetime(local_ts, unit="s", errors="coerce")
    out["hour_local"] = local_dt.dt.hour.fillna(0)

    out["hour_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * out["hour_local"] / 24.0)
    out["hour_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * out["hour_local"] / 24.0)
    out["weekday_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * out["weekday"] / 7.0)
    out["weekday_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * out["weekday"] / 7.0)

    # Text statistics
    body = (
        df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").astype(str)
        if "request_text_edit_aware" in df.columns
        else pd.Series("", index=df.index)
    )
    title = (
        df["request_title"].fillna("").astype(str)
        if "request_title" in df.columns
        else pd.Series("", index=df.index)
    )
    body = body.replace("nan", "", regex=False).replace("None", "", regex=False)
    title = title.replace("nan", "", regex=False).replace("None", "", regex=False)
    text = body.str.strip() + " " + title.str.strip()
    lower_text = text.str.lower()

    out["text_len"] = text.str.len()
    out["word_len"] = text.str.split().str.len().fillna(0)
    out["avg_word_len"] = out["text_len"] / (out["word_len"] + 1)
    out["num_sentences"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]+")
    out["num_question"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    out["num_exclam"] = text.str.count(r"!")
    out["num_period"] = text.str.count(r"\.")
    out["num_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    out["upper_ratio"] = out["num_upper"] / (out["text_len"] + 1)
    out["punct_count"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    out["punct_ratio"] = out["punct_count"] / (out["text_len"] + 1)

    out["title_len"] = title.str.len()
    out["title_words"] = title.str.split().str.len().fillna(0)
    out["title_question"] = title.str.count(r"\?")
    out["title_exclam"] = title.str.count(r"!")
    out["body_len"] = body.str.len()
    out["body_words"] = body.str.split().str.len().fillna(0)
    out["body_avg_word_len"] = out["body_len"] / (out["body_words"] + 1)
    out["body_newlines"] = body.str.count("\n")
    out["body_paragraphs"] = body.str.split("\n\n").str.len().fillna(1)
    out["body_has_url"] = body.str.contains("http", regex=False).astype(int)
    out["body_has_imgur"] = lower_text.str.contains("imgur", regex=False).astype(int)

    out["money_count"] = lower_text.str.count(r"\$")
    out["has_financial"] = lower_text.str.contains(
        r"\b(pay|bills|rent|cash|money)\b", regex=True
    ).astype(int)
    out["request_pizza"] = lower_text.str.contains(r"\bpizza\b", regex=True).astype(int)
    out["title_caps"] = title.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    out["title_caps_ratio"] = out["title_caps"] / (out["title_len"] + 1)

    positive_words = [
        "thanks",
        "thank",
        "appreciate",
        "love",
        "great",
        "happy",
        "birthday",
        "please",
        "kind",
        "generous",

    negative_words = [
        "unemployed",

        "disabled",

        "money",
